entities.summary: Angel Deradoorian, also known mononymously as Deradoorian, is a musician based in Los Angeles, California. She is best known for her work with Dirty Projectors as full-time member from 2007 to 2012. She left to pursue a solo career. In 2015 she released a solo studio album, The Expanding Flower Planet. Angel Deradoorian was a composers & musicians from Orangevale (b. 1986-07-18, Orangevale). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
